card.name: Words just before "steady state"
card.fires_on: Verbs like reach, reached, reaches, or until, right before the phrase steady state (or stable/equilibrium) when drug concentrations settle. It also fires on "new" in "reach the new steady state".

modes.label: Reach verb
modes.description: A form of reach after drug concentrations or levels, leading into steady state.
modes.example: allow serum theophylline concentrations to<< reach>> the new steady state.

modes.label: Until stable levels
modes.description: The word until or an adjacent word that sets up stable or steady concentrations.
modes.example: Close monitoring of immunosuppressant concentrations for at least 2 weeks (<<until>> stable concentrations are reached) is recommended when

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word steady (or stable) next, including in Chinese forms.
card.plain: It fires on the words that come right before "steady state" when a drug's blood level levels off.
